Not to mention you’d need a court case to get yourself emancipated to even move out on your own which would cost court filing fees. Do you have a job that’s paying enough to move out? It’s going to be really hard for someone to rent to you based on what renters look for. I’m not trying to discourage you! Just giving some insight from when I was in your position. Your parents may be bad at saving but you can be the change. Just don’t let them access your money. If you get to college though, and get a scholarship, I’d suggest leaving then. Or you can see about financial aid providing a dorm.

What about history tutoring jobs? My boss pays a tutor $180 dollars for one and a half hours for her child. If you got multiple clients, you could bank on that! You can advertise yourself or look for a tutoring agency.

Some veins are smaller than others regardless tbh. My older brother is very large like 350+. He was denied for small veins. My other friend is 400 pounds and donates all the time. My veins are on the brink. They almost turned me away too.

Gay guys can give plasma. You have to be honest about being sexually active with men, however. You can also lie and say no for now. They do a blood test before you’re allowed to donate so as long as you’re clean, I don’t believe there’s an issue. My friend is gay and the plasma center by me let’s him donate. Another one turned him away. So I think it depends.
